subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The BYD Seal
description: A fast breakdown of The BYD Seal for builders.

hook.text: BYD went from making phone batteries to building the world's most popular electric cars.

buildup.text: The Seal is a sleek sedan competing directly with the Tesla Model 3—at a significantly lower price.

discovery.text: BYD makes its own batteries, chips, and motors. Vertical integration gives it a massive cost advantage.

twist.text: In 2023, BYD passed Tesla in global EV sales by volume. The student surpassed the teacher.

climax.text: Western automakers now study BYD the way they once studied Toyota's production system.

punchline.text: A battery company became the world's biggest EV maker.

quiz.question: What gives BYD a major cost advantage?

details.summary: The BYD Seal is a Chinese electric sedan that offers competitive range, performance, and technology at a price significantly below Western rivals, representing China's challenge to global EV leaders.
details.whyItMatters: The Seal demonstrates that Chinese automakers can build world-class EVs at lower prices, threatening the market share of Tesla, Volkswagen, and other established players in Europe and beyond.
takeaways: BYD uses its own Blade Battery for safety and cost control
The Seal competes directly with the Tesla Model 3
It launched in Europe at prices well below comparable Western EVs

faq.question: Is the BYD Seal as good as a Tesla Model 3?
faq.answer: Reviews suggest the Seal matches or exceeds the Model 3 in interior quality and ride comfort while costing less. Tesla still leads in charging network and software, but the gap is narrowing rapidly.

faq.question: What makes BYD different from other Chinese EV makers?
faq.answer: BYD manufactures its own batteries, chips, and motors, giving it vertical integration rivaling Tesla. This control over the supply chain allows aggressive pricing while maintaining healthy profit margins.
